        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

import numpy as np, json
G=load()
def iterate(g, nb):
    H,W=g.shape
    def nbv(r,c,nb): return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in nb if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W]
    g=np.array(g); best=None
    for _ in range(100):
        new=g.copy(); changed=False
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                vals=[g[y,x] for y,x in nbv(r,c,nb)]
                if len(vals)>=3 and set(vals)!={g[r,c]} and vals.count(g[r,c])<len(vals)-vals.count(list(set(vals)-{g[r,c]})[0]):
                    pass
        # simpler: majority vote over non-self neighbors
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                vals=[g[y,x] for y,x in nbv(r,c,nb)]
                if not vals: continue
                maj=max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
                if g[r,c]!=maj: new[r,c]=maj; changed=True
        if not changed: break
        g=new
    return g,changed

def maj5(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape

        new=g.copy(); changed=False

import os,re,json
def parse(t):
    G={}
    t=t.replace('\\n','\n')
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,glob,re,collections,numpy as np,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    keep=[c for c in range(gi.shape[1]) if (gi[:,c]!=bg).any()]
